I.e. ... `` `Other stuff` `` I tried first with: `.. raw:: html` `` which works fine. However, when I turn this into a replacement (for convenience) I get the comment line embedded in `

`'s. I also tried doing it as a role, e.g. `.. role:: raw-custom(raw)` `:format: html` but this just wraps my comment text in a `` with the class name of the role. Any idea why making the basic raw directive into a replacement changes the output html? MWE attached.
